messages:
nicole: quick thought — can we surface an "estimated units" hint in the console for embeddings requests? idea: show estimated token/byte units + a suggested split if the payload looks large. would help support + customers avoid 413 surprises
rajan: +1. we already compute dim/byte heuristics in ingress. question: should the hint be 'bytes first' or 'dims first'? different customers care about one or the other.
evelyn: from runtime POV dims are more stable predictor of cost for our quantized models. bytes are noisy due to encoding, but bytes determine transport limits. maybe show both: "estimated units (dims)" and "payload size" with a split recommendation.
sam: UX: short and scannable. "Estimated billing units: 3.2k (dims) — Suggest splitting into 4 requests" with an expandable detail panel explaining the math. avoid jargon like 'KV cache' in the hint.
nicole: nice. telemetry ask: we should emit an event when the console shows the hint and when user clicks 'apply suggested split' so we can measure lift. propose metric name: embed_console.preflight_hint.shown / .applied
rajan: agree. runtime needs a boolean header to opt clients into 'preflight advice' so we don't run cost math for every API call. header: `X-Embed-Preflight: 1` — lightweight probe, returns `x-embed-hint: dims=1280;size=5120;split=4` in a 204 response from preflight endpoint.
evelyn: minor nit: avoid adding sync preflight to main path; implement as separate /v1/embeddings/preflight that accepts same body but only runs estimation. we can rate-limit it and mark low-cost on billing.
sam: sounds good. console flow: call preflight when user uploads a file or pastes a big array. show hint inline. let user toggle 'auto preflight' in settings.
nicole: deploy plan? we can ship UI behind flag first, enable telemetry, then flip to default.
rajan: I'll add server-side flag and the header. rollout plan: canary 10% of accounts -> 50% -> 100% over a week. runtime-bot: deploy requested by rajan: canary rollout started for flag embed-preflight-console (10%) :rocket:
evelyn: implementation detail: estimation uses the same dim model math as splitter service but we need to be careful about mixed-dim arrays — when dims vary we should show 'mixed dims — prefer client-side split' rather than a suspicious single number.
nicole: good point. message for support: when we show 'mixed dims' include a sample curl with suggested chunking. e.g. ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": [ ...first-512-items..., "..." ]}'
```
sam: can we also expose a small line in the model route dashboard showing percent of requests that triggered the hint and conversion rate (applied split)? product wants that.
rajan: yes telemetry events above + console will emit `embed_console.preflight_shown` with dims,size,tenant_id, and `embed_console.preflight_applied`. we should add a per-route grafana panel.
evelyn: runtime note: ensure preflight estimation uses the same tokenization/byte accounting as billing. otherwise we'll get mismatches and tickets. double-check with billing team.
nicole: action items: rajan = server preflight endpoint + header + flags, evelyn = ensure estimator parity w/ billing, sam = console UI mock + settings toggle, i'll own telemetry naming + dashboard. will sync tomorrow at 11. :thumbsup:
